A1.justification: Both PDFs describe LaGen and contain complete, readable main text, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–J. Textual and rendered-page comparisons support reliable assessment throughout.

before.justification: v2 reports original LaGen generation, forecasting, detection, ablation, and robustness results in Section 4 and Appendices H–J.

after.justification: v3 retains these original quantitative experiments and qualitative generation results, including the appendix evaluations.

M1.justification: The latent-diffusion architecture, conditioning, scene decoupling estimation, noise modulation, losses, and autoregressive procedure are unchanged. Appendix B still specifies circular convolutions; only their citation is removed.

E1.justification: Both versions use nuScenes and KITTI-360 with the same generation, temporal-consistency, detection, forecasting, editing, and robustness coverage. Standardizing the spelling of nuScenes does not change the dataset.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain the same baselines, including LiDARGen, LiDM, RangeLDM, UniScene, OpenDWM, OpenDWM-DiT, DriveLiDAR4D, LiDARCrafter, 4D-Occ, and ViDAR. Changed citation numbers do not represent comparator changes.

E3.justification: Dataset splits, evaluation metrics, input-frame counts, prediction horizons, training budgets, denoising steps, and bounding-box perturbation settings remain unchanged in Section 4 and Appendices B, C, and H.

E4.justification: Both retain the SDE and noise-modulation ablations, denoising-step analysis, bounding-box shifting/dropping robustness tests, object-editing demonstration, and appendix driving-scenario comparisons.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. The same point-estimate reporting is retained.

E6.justification: Numerical results in main Tables 1–9 and supplementary Tables 1–5 are unchanged, as are the qualitative outputs and plotted trends. For example, Table 1 retains LaGen's MMD of 0.11 and JSD of 2.77 in its stated scaled units.

T1.justification: The main method equations and appendix metric definitions, projection formulas, noise-modulation derivation, and scene-decoupling analysis are unchanged. No assumptions, mathematical arguments, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about interactive autoregressive LiDAR generation from a single initial frame, the SDE and noise-modulation contributions, and generation and forecasting performance.

C2.justification: The interpretations of temporal consistency, error accumulation, conditioning, and long-horizon performance are unchanged. Section 4.7 retains the same sensor restrictions and crowded-scene matching limitations.

D1.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendix B retain the same hyperparameters, pretrained VAE information, circular convolutions, hardware, and training-time disclosures. The code-availability statement and repository address are also unchanged.

R1.justification: v3 removes Schubert et al.'s Circular convolutional neural networks for panoramic images and laser data, formerly reference 53, and its citation in Appendix B. Other references are renumbered, while the substantive research positioning remains unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 standardizes nuScenes capitalization in the contribution list and Table 1 caption, expands the funding acknowledgments, and updates the version/date marking. The narrative and section organization remain intact.

P2.justification: There are small spacing and placement adjustments on page 15, bibliography reflow following the reference removal, and minor caption/text reflow. No figures or tables are added, removed, or substantively redesigned.

improvement.justification: The methods, empirical evidence, theoretical analysis, and limitations are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. Minor spelling corrections and fuller funding disclosure accompany the loss of one implementation citation; these limited edits do not materially change the paper's overall quality.
